profile.jobTitle: Goverment Blue Force Tracking Aviation Field Software Engineer (GS12)
profile.summary:
Confident, highly energized, effective and persuasive communicator with strong interpersonal and communication skills. Detail and results oriented with a proven ability to demonstrate flawless execution and implementation of innovative strategies with a record of managing multiple tasks effectively. An analytical and strategic thinker with the highest professional standards and personal integrity. 

Highly experienced professional with a record of aligning critical initiatives to core business objectives, developing and supporting successful projects and solutions incorporating a wide range of applications and technologies. Expert in client relationship management and effective business communication. 

A builder of high performance teams and a natural Team Leader, Mentor, and Motivator who thrives in environments requiring a high level strategist and a big picture thinker. Proven Project Management skills utilized in driving profitable and cost effective collaboration between critical business functions. 

Highly focused on teamwork and leadership. Well aware of the bottom line and exceeding both internal and external customers conditions for success. Challenges are to be sought out and met, tested against, and ultimately overcome through hard work and insight gained by making cost effective, strategic contributions. 

5 years supervisory experience 

over 5 years aircraft maintainer experience 

3 years law enforcement 

Over 9 years working with the military 



Specialties: Project Management Process Analysis Process Review Process Improvement Team Leadership 
Forecasting Development/Problem Identification and Resolution/Vendor Management 
Effective Communicatio/ Mentoring/Training/ Blue Force Tracking Aviation FBCB2/CPOF/MCS/ABCS/ BFT 2/JCR
COMPTIA security + and COMPTIA A + certified

positions.title: Goverment Blue Force Tracking Aviation Field Software Engineer (GS12)
positions.description: Sustainment support for Medevac and VIP aviation units assigned to Ft Irwin CA, as well as full time sustainment support for all units coming in to Ft Irwin for training rotation. FSE supports up to 30 aircraft of multiple airframes each rotations with 10 to 11 rotations each fiscal year

positions.title: BFT field service engineer
positions.description: Qinetiq North America was purchased by The SI group and reconsituted into Vencore

positions.title: Blue Force Tracking Aviation Field Service Rep
positions.description:
BFT Aviation Field Service Representative 
Key leader responsible for troubleshooting the Blue Force Tracking (BFT) system on military aircraft, of multiple airframes, repairing components that are repairable and replacing those that is not. Work on BFT components when the unit level maintainer is unable to repair the problem. Proficient in electronic and electrical repair and diagnostics 
Able to use a multi-meter and do depot level repairs on small components including wire and cable repair and circuit repair 

Trained on both the terrestrial FBCB2 and the satellite based BFT systems on multiple software versions including the current firmware version used on the today systems. 

Coordinate between the military and government contractors to ensure the aircraft that needed work were available and to complete work without conflicting with mission set. 

Supervise OLR teams during installation of new BFT kits on to airframes and responsible for the MOC of that airframe upon completion of installation. 

Troubleshooting and fault isolation, repair for hardware components as well as software to keep system operational and mission ready at all times. 

Repair and rebuild circuits and canon plugs and coax connections

positions.title: Flight Operations NCO
positions.locationName: Fort Hood Tx/ Camp Taji Iraq
positions.description:
Monitored up to 5 separate radio frequencies as well as tracking multiple aircraft including medical evacuation aircraft and dispatching them into the landing zone to retrieve patients. Took all relevant information from the unit requesting the evacuation including patients? status and whether or not there were hostile enemy in the area that would endanger the aircraft or crew. 

Used BFT and Force Battle Command Brigade and Below (FBCB2) in a combat environment. Accountable for training the unit level users of the BFT and the FBCB2 systems ensuring a proper understanding of the system and it?s abilities as an asset to an aviation operations. 

Trained at the administrator level on the Movement Command System (MCS) as well as the MCS gateway. Trained both superiors and subordinates in the use and operation of these systems. 

Accountable for setting up the tactical operations center kits and making sure all users were able to operate it and tear it down and set it back up as needed for mission flow. 

Received training all of the on the Army Battle Command Systems.

positions.title: Detention Deputy
positions.description:
Certified as a Florida State Corrections Officer as well as a medical first responder. Accountable for the care, custody and control of up to 72 county, states and federal sentenced inmates or inmates awaiting trial. Maintained daily log, search prisoners, cells, and vehicles for weapons, valuables, or drugs. 

Trained in use of chemical restraints such as pepper spray and tear gas, also qualified to use electronic restraints such as the Nova Stun belt. 

Responded to emergencies inside the facility such as fights, attempted suicides and assault on staff.

projects.title: Site lead BFT Aviation K16 Airbase South Korea
projects.description: Respnsible for supporting BFT AVN operations for 2-2 assault battallion at K16 Airbase and Japan Aviation battallion at Camp Zama Japan. over 40 airframes in my care responsible for all troubleshooting and repairs on mutiple airframes.

projects.title: Foward Operating Base Salnero Site Lead
projects.description: As site lead I was reponsible for Blue Force Tracking Aviation Sustainment Operation for a Task Force Sized Element in Afghanistan. I was responsible for over 39 platforms. Keeping a running and accurate status report on all airframes as well as extra parts
